title: Field Mutability Belongs to the Binding
goal: Make a struct field editable by declaring the variable binding mutable.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: User-Defined Types

hints: Rust does not allow `mut` on individual field definitions in a struct.
To modify a struct field, the variable holding the struct must be declared mutable with `let mut`.
explanation: In Rust, mutability is a property of the variable binding (`let mut`), not individual struct fields. You cannot write `mut x: i32` inside a struct definition. Writing `let p = p;` creates an immutable binding, causing error `E0594` when mutating `p.x`. Writing `let &mut p = p;` fails with `E0308` due to a type mismatch against `Point`.
